name: Katagiri Yui
source:
[b]A Former Soldier and a Cross-Dressing Boy[/b]

Zodiac: Libra

The protagonist of the story. Due to certain circumstances, he has to hide his true identity and live in an area full of women. He is recruited as a cadet by an AI, becoming a student at Acacia Academy. Because of his tragic past as a child soldier in the men's world, he has mixed feelings toward the society dominated by women.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://orthrossoft.jp/character/index.html#yuii]official website[/url]]
